name: Saint Basil`s Cathedral
description: Basil's Cathedral, also translated as St. Basil's Cathedral, is located at the southern end of the Red Square outside the Moscow Kremlin. It was built by Ivan the Terrible to commemorate his victory over the Mongol invaders. It was started in 1555 AD and completed in 1560 AD. It is the main representative of Russian architecture in the mid-to-late 16th century. The church has a unique architectural style. Its brilliant colors, disordered lines, and onion-shaped dome spire have become a model for churches across Russia, full of fairy tale colors.
